title: Payment-Method Schedule for Late-Fee Reversals
content:
**Schedule.** Under the payment-method schedule of Student Enrollment, Transfers and Pre-Kindergarten Admissions, a family whose Pre-K tuition account shows tuition payments by personal check or money order in the school year has an amount added to a late-fee reversal:

| Tuition payments by personal check or money order on the enrollment in the school year | Added to the reversal |
|---|---|
| two or more | 5.00 |
| exactly one | 2.50 |
| none | nothing |

Personal checks and money orders are counted together; online card and ACH bank draft payments are not counted.

## Examples (hypothetical enrollments)

| Payments this school year | Counted | Added |
|---|---|---|
| three personal checks | 3 | 5.00 |
| one money order, two online card payments | 1 | 2.50 |
| five ACH bank drafts | 0 | nothing |
